title: fix(plugin-email)!: retire renderTemplate, the render export that takes an email template body with no save moment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEyF7AtCnTe94fR7XzB94BG)_
Fixes #25190

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file names the retired package export, and `content/docs/**` names only `services.email`'s `renderTemplate` method (`automation/email-templates.mdx` lines 14, 224, 261), which stays; nothing teaches the removed export

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么**：`@objectstack/plugin-email` 的包入口不再导出 `renderTemplate` 函数；函数本身留在包内，邮件服务照常用它渲染已存储的邮件模板。
- **为什么改**：这个导出直接接收一段模板正文并当场渲染，没有保存环节，邮件 HTML 洞位规则（在编写/发布时判定）看不到它；退役后不再有规则看不见的渲染入口。这是本卡的第二个也是最后一个 PR（`renderNotification` 已由 #25285 退役）。
- **风险与回滚**：本仓与 hotcrm 从包入口导入它的数量为 0；外部若有直接导入者会在自己的 import 处得到编译错误，changeset 写明改用 `services.email` 的 `renderTemplate` / `sendTemplate`。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/index.ts`（删除的那一行导出）；`.changeset/25190-retire-render-template-export.md`（BREAKING 说明与 FROM → TO）；`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/render-export-retired.pin.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`，预期 exit 0 且打印 `verified: @objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes
- `renderTemplate` leaves the published entry of `@objectstack/plugin-email` (ruling `6335348115` on #25082, F2 B3; ruling `6349343463` letter A, item 4). The module-internal function stays: `EmailService.sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate` keep rendering stored `email_template` items through it.
- `requireVars` and `htmlToText` stay on the entry. `IEmailService.renderTemplate` (the spec contract method of the same name) is a different door and is untouched. `interpolate` (service-messaging) stays, per ruling `6349343463` item 2.
- One `patch` changeset with the BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired @objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate`, and a FROM → TO line naming the service door. No staged window.

## Tests
- New `src/render-export-retired.pin.test.ts` (3 cases): the entry has no `renderTemplate`; control: `requireVars`, `htmlToText`, `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader`, `EmailServicePlugin` are still exported; a stored template renders by name through `EmailService.renderTemplate` and `sendTemplate`, html hole encoded, subject verbatim.
- Reverse check (one-off, no permanent file): with the base `index.ts` restored, the retired-name case went red (1 failed, 2 passed); restored with `git checkout HEAD`, HEAD blob hash matched.

## Acceptance notes
- Restart line of the hold (`6351169534`) measured on this real head, not from the record: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0, `verified: @objectstack/plugin-email#renderTemplate (export, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts)`.
- Readers swept: no import of `renderTemplate` from `@objectstack/plugin-email` anywhere in this tree (tests, `ui/`, examples, docs, `docs/qa/**`, `scripts/**` included) or in `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`. `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` names `renderTemplate({ template, data, locale })`, which is the service method, so it stays as written. No `skills/**` reader. The spec api-surface snapshots do not cover plugin-email.
- npm dependants: NOT MEASURED. The registry has no dependants index; its text search ignores a `dependencies:` qualifier and returns unrelated packages.
- Open PRs touching `packages/plugins/plugin-email/**`: none, read at start (20 open) and again before opening this PR (31 open).
